description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM hires an Application Developer – Cloud FullStack to develop and deploy secure cloud-based applications. The role integrates front-end, back-end, and middleware components, applies DevOps practices, and collaborates on cloud environments and technology integration.
Full-Stack Cloud Application Developer developing microservices applications, integrating APIs and databases, and deploying through DevOps practices

Responsibilities:
• Develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components, and persisting data in NoSQL or RDBMS databases
• Utilize DevOps methodologies and tools to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications
• Work with senior level practitioners to design, build, and maintain cloud environments, focusing on uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools
• Integrate multiple technologies, including Angular, React, CSS3, HTML5, Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, Groovy, REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and NoSQL/RDBMS databases, to deliver comprehensive cloud-based solutions

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Exposure to developing and deploying cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components, and persisting data in NoSQL or RDBMS databases
• Experience working with multiple layers of application development, including front-end technologies such as Angular, React, CSS3, and HTML5, and back-end technologies such as Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, and Groovy
• Exposure to utilizing DevOps methodologies and tools to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications
• Experience working with cloud environments, focusing on uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools
• Exposure to integrating multiple technologies, including REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and NoSQL/RDBMS databases, to deliver comprehensive cloud-based solutions
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Java, Springboot Microservices, AWS Cloud & DevOps, React/Angular
• Exposure to implementing cloud security measures, including network security and access control, to ensure the integrity of cloud-based applications
• Experience working with advanced DevOps tools and methodologies to optimize the development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications
• Exposure to designing, building, and maintaining multi-cloud environments, focusing on uptime, scalability, and automation
• Java, Springboot Microservices, AWS Cloud & DevOps, React/Angular
